title: Block Movement / flat / 32003
description: Which sequence produces the entire final arrangement?
question: Use the 3 x 3 x 1 board. Each pair shows the same stack from opposite sides. Coordinates (x,y,z) follow the axes, starting at zero. Move the cube at the named current cell one unit. An occupied target swaps with the mover. An empty elevated target needs support immediately before the move. After each step, settle every column downward, preserving its order. Equal colors are interchangeable. Which sequence produces the entire final arrangement?

answer.explanation: green (1, 2, 0) to (2, 2, 0). Then green (2, 2, 0) to (1, 2, 0). Then gold (1, 1, 0) to (0, 1, 0). Every displayed constraint matches.

options.label: A
options.explanation: green (1, 2, 0) to (2, 2, 0). Then green (2, 2, 0) to (1, 2, 0). Then gold (1, 1, 0) to (2, 1, 0). Step 3, cell (0, 1, 0) contains empty. The panel requires gold.

options.label: B
options.explanation: green (1, 2, 0) to (2, 2, 0). Then green (2, 2, 0) to (2, 1, 0). Then gold (1, 1, 0) to (0, 1, 0). Step 3, cell (1, 2, 0) contains empty. The panel requires green.

options.label: C
options.explanation: green (1, 2, 0) to (2, 2, 0). Then green (2, 2, 0) to (1, 2, 0). Then gold (1, 1, 0) to (0, 1, 0). Every displayed constraint matches.

options.label: D
options.explanation: green (1, 2, 0) to (2, 2, 0). Then gold (1, 1, 0) to (1, 0, 0), exchanging with gold. Then gold (1, 1, 0) to (0, 1, 0). Step 3, cell (1, 2, 0) contains empty. The panel requires green.
